object_description: large courtyard-centered volume with internal hall
design_condition: The large volume is placed along the road and generates outdoor spaces of different characters, but its terracing contributes to fragmentation within the site.

positive.statement: The volume confidently derives its geometry from the location and creates outdoor spaces with different characters.
The differentiated public and campus entrances are plausible.
The inner courtyard offers exciting visual connections and spatial experiences.
The upper-floor plans are clearly organized along the corridor bordering the inner courtyard.
The solid support structure is clearly designed and consistently supported on aligned supports and cores.
Summer heat protection can be easily achieved, and the CO₂-controlled ventilation is state of the art.

negative.statement: The setting creates a certain fragmentation, and the terracing is perceived as an unnecessary disruption.
The auditorium has more the character of a foyer or open hall and is limited by its height and balconies.
Dividing the lunch table into two areas is not optimal for operation.
The ground-floor corridors cannot do justice to the expected spaciousness.
The permeable structure is too demanding in operation with multiple uses and parallel occupancy.
The large projections into the courtyard require optimization for storage of the surrounding wall panels.
The large volume, sophisticated structure, and solid construction imply a rather high expenditure of resources.
